name: Onion-skin trail
visual_intent: Fading ghost copies replay a move a few frames behind, exposing its path, spacing and easing: the animator's onion skin used as an on-screen explanation.

performance_characteristics.memory_profile: Low; scales with clone count and target complexity (estimate)

implementation_summary: Clones the target count times into fixed-opacity wrappers behind it and runs the same motion function on each clone with a time lag; ghosts are hidden after the move. Works with any motion built from fromTo tweens.
runtime_api: Studio.space.trail(tl, target, at, motion(tl, el, at) -> end, {count, lag, opacity, hold})

validation.evidence: Runtime self-test (ghost count, ghost lags original, ghosts hidden after the move) in Playwright Chromium on Windows, 2026-10-30.
